domain: Unchanged native random domain; explicit adversarial colors obey every native panel invariant. Covers all native panel sizes, panel counts and target positions. Does not enumerate all pixel fillings.
proof: For smaller proposed period q<=s, a full candidate line intersects the unique target panel and a perpendicular real divider. Its colour must be D at the latter, but inside the target only 0 or F appears, neither D. Hence no smaller period exists. The true divider period exists; the unique {0,F} panel is selected.
